do_not_cross_barrier.name: Do Not Cross — Barrier
do_not_cross_barrier.description: A line you must not cross, rebuilt PROCEDURALLY - no glb, every mesh built in _ready(). Two forms as a declared axis: `sawhorse` (the New York police barricade - a straight wooden plank painted NYPD blue on A-frame legs, the legend stencilled white on both faces) and `tape` (two steel posts and a ribbon hung as a TRUE catenary, a*cosh(x/a) with the constant solved by Newton from span and sag - wave 17 published 'the catenary that is a parabola' as a defect, so a barrier shipped after that finding does not repeat it; measured honestly, at the default 0.18 m sag the catenary is 0.19 mm from the parabola, so the honesty is in the arithmetic, not the look). The legend is a PARAMETER now (legend_text), not baked geometry. Pairs with walk_this_line_marking, the floor half: the tape forbids crossing the line, the paint commands following it.

measurements.source: authored glTF, read from accessor bounds

dev_themes: the line as instrument of exclusion
do_not_cross_barrier.qfep_connection: Point_Lines argues that measure is also violence — what does not fit the grid is remainder, error, erased. This and its companion are that argument as furniture, standing in PERPENDICULAR relations to one line: the tape forbids crossing it, the paint commands following it.
